blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution in the International Criminal Court (ICC) has asserted that its body of evidence against former President Rodrigo Duterte is massive because it shows that the drug war was so “widespread and systematic” that it led to thousands of killings. The prosecution, in a Sept. 29 redacted version of its response to a defense motion on the volume of evidence, said this in urging the Trial Chamber (TC) III to not put a cap of just 10,000 items to its disclosure. “[T]he dataset is large because it records the deaths of the thousands of individuals killed by […]...
